t1.note: Find a participant. Sit them across from you, with the player between you. Then play tape 2.

t2.note: Let the tape talk to your participant. When they nod, play tape 3.

t3.note: When they tell you they have their word, play tape 4.

t4.note: Two fingers on your temple. Tell them, don't ask. Wait for their answer, then play tape 5.
t4.say: There is an A in your word.

t5y.note: Fingers on your temple. Have them picture the whole word again. Then play tape 6.

t5n.note: That was the test letter. Ask them to focus harder. Then play tape 6.

t6yy.note: A slow breath, both of you. Be a little less certain. Then play tape 7.

t6yn.note: Lower your hand. Say it firmly. Agree or correct, either is fine. Then play tape 7.
t6yn.say: What you drew is not a living thing.

t6ny.note: Lower your hand. Have them see it in front of them, life size. Then play tape 7.

t6nn.note: A picture thinker. Forget the letters. Have them look at the thing itself. Then play tape 7.

t7s.note: Whatever they answer, don't say a word. Skip tape 8. Play the red tape.
t7s.say: I'm not sure about this one. Is there an S?

t7r.note: The letters are finished. Lower your hand. Then play tape 8.

t7hold.note: Hold out your hands, palms up. Then play tape 8.
t7hold.say: Could you pick it up and hold it in your hands?

t7man.note: Don't ask anything else. Skip tape 8. Play the red tape.

t7live.note: Whatever they answer, don't say a word. Skip tape 8. Play the red tape.

t7sun.note: Don't ask anything else. Skip tape 8. Play the red tape.

t7big.note: Whatever they answer, don't say a word. Skip tape 8. Play the red tape.

t7touch.note: Whatever they answer, don't say a word. Skip tape 8. Play the red tape.

t8small.note: Whatever they answer, don't say a word. Play the red tape.

t8home.note: Whatever they answer, don't say a word. Play the red tape.
t8home.say: Is there one in your home?

t8hard.note: Whatever they answer, don't say a word. Play the red tape.

t8own.note: Whatever they answer, don't say a word. Play the red tape.
